spec_match.rationale: Maps the change's scope statement ('non-XSLT scenarios') onto real code paths: DOMParser, XHR responseXML, SVG-as-XML each exercised live, and XSLTProcessor run through a real transform as the named exclusion.

interactive.rationale: One button re-exercises all four surfaces with genuine parses, a real Blob-URL XHR, and a real XSLT transform.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises every path exercised for real including the exclusion; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Each surface distinguishes success, wrong-result, thrown, and (for XSLT) not-exposed outcomes.

conformance.rationale: The suite's XHR, SVG, and XSLT assertions are these cards as self-contained checks.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: all four cards green — namespace+entity parse, feed→item over XHR, SVGSVGElement root, and a working one-template XSLT transform on the legacy path; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Result chips emerald/amber/rose on stone (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Each card's result is its own aria-live region; headings number the surfaces; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column cards with wrapping results; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give each exercised surface its own announced result.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Four aria-live result chips, one per surface.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long results inside bordered cards.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: overflow-wrap on results; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all four surfaces exercised with real operations on Chromium 141 — including a genuine working XSLT transform proving the exclusion's path still functions. Clean console, both viewports; no open questions.
